description: Build a matched audience from HubSpot contacts or companies. Pass exactly 1 source: a HubSpot listId (its members), or filters for a CRM search (all ANDed). Reads every page, cleans the records like a CSV upload, and uploads only SHA256 email hashes for contacts (name and website for companies). Pass dryRun=true first: it returns counts and a masked sample and uploads nothing. Needs a HubSpot private app token on this machine (ADWARP_HUBSPOT_TOKEN or ~/.adwarp/hubspot.json); matching takes up to 48h.

accountId.description: LinkedIn ad account id; defaults to config defaultAccountId

dryRun.description: Return counts and a masked sample without uploading anything

filters.description: CRM search filters, all ANDed (HubSpot allows up to 6 per group). Pass this or listId, not both.

property.description: HubSpot property internal name, e.g. lifecyclestage

value.description: Value to compare. IN and NOT_IN take a comma-separated list, BETWEEN takes 'low,high', HAS_PROPERTY and NOT_HAS_PROPERTY take none.

listId.description: HubSpot list id (the ILS list id). Pass this or filters, not both.

type.description: contact or company. With listId it defaults to the list's object type; with filters it defaults to contact.

name: audience_from_hubspot
